title: Dialysis Loop Test Failure — Do Not Drink Advisory

transcript.speaker: Beth Kowalczyk, RN
transcript.text: Dr. Shah, it's Beth Kowalczyk at the Outpatient Dialysis Center. I just ran the loop tests on the reverse osmosis system, and the total chlorine at the carbon bed outlet is 0.35 mg/L — above the 0.1 mg/L limit. The conductivity at the RO output is 8 μS/cm, and the machine disinfect log shows no recent cycles. The city has issued a Do Not Drink advisory, so I'm not starting any patients until we confirm the loop is safe. I've paused the 07:00 session and are calling patients to reschedule.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anita Shah
transcript.text: Understood, Beth. Hold all starts. Confirm total chlorine at the carbon bed outlet, conductivity at the RO output, and review the disinfect log for the last 48 hours. We cannot start any machines until all three pass. Call me back when you have the data.
